get_character.description: Get everything recorded about one Avatar: The Last Airbender or Legend of Korra character by id or by name: picture, gender, affiliation, profession, position, predecessor, weapon, love interest, allies, enemies and first appearance. A name is matched ignoring case and accents, whole or in part, but must fit one character; otherwise the step fails naming those it fits. No API key required.

character.description: One character, and everything the API records about them.

affiliation.description: The nations and groups they belong to, several run together as the wiki listed them, e.g. 'Air Acolytes Air Nomads Air Scouts (formerly) Team Avatar', or null.

allies.description: The names of their allies as the API records them, usually only the first the wiki lists, e.g. ['Appa']. Some are groups, such as 'Fire Nation'. Empty when none is recorded.

enemies.description: The names of their enemies as the API records them, usually only the first the wiki lists, e.g. ['Azula']. Some are groups, such as 'Fire Nation'. Empty when none is recorded.

eye_color.description: Their eye colour, e.g. 'Gray' or 'Gold', or null.

first_appearance.description: Where they first appeared, when the API kept it, e.g. 'North and South Part One' or 'Unaired pilot'. Null for most characters.

gender.description: 'Male' or 'Female', or both for a pair, e.g. 'Male (Baraz) Female (Ahnah)'. Null when none is recorded.

hair_color.description: Their hair colour, e.g. 'Dark brown', or null.

id.description: The character's id, 24 letters and digits, e.g. '5cf5679a915ecad153ab68c9' for Aang. Get a character takes it.

image.description: A link to the character's picture on the Avatar Wiki, or null when there is none.

love_interest.description: Who they love or loved, several run together as the wiki listed them, e.g. 'Katara', or null.

name.description: The character's name, e.g. 'Toph Beifong'. Their versions from the video games and the unaired pilot have names of their own, e.g. 'Aang (games)'.

position.description: The positions they have held, several run together as the wiki listed them, e.g. 'Fully Realized Avatar', or null.

predecessor.description: Who held their position before them, e.g. 'Roku' for Aang, or null.

profession.description: What they do, several run together as the wiki listed them, e.g. 'Air Nomad culture teacher Airbending instructor Avatar Monk', or null.

skin_color.description: Their skin colour, e.g. 'Light', or 'Fur' for Appa, or null.

weapon.description: What they fight with, for a bender usually their element, e.g. 'Fire, lightning' or 'The elements', or null.

description: Look up the characters of Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra with the free, keyless Last Airbender API: 497 characters, from Aang, Katara and Zuko to Korra, each with what the Avatar Wiki on Fandom records of their picture, gender, affiliation, profession, position, predecessor, weapon, love interest, allies and enemies. Search them, look one up, pick them at random or list the Avatars. No account or API key required. Disclaimer: this is an independent integration with the community-run Last Airbender API.
